headword: スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}
gloss: super bathhouse; large public bath complex

definitions.gloss: super bathhouse; large public bath complex
definitions.explanation: A large-scale public bathing facility that offers various types of baths, saunas, and amenities beyond a traditional public bath, often including restaurants and relaxation areas.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}はスーパー{銭湯|せんとう}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I go to the super bathhouse on weekends.

examples.japanese: スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}でゆっくり{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: I spent a relaxing time at the super bathhouse.

examples.japanese: このスーパー{銭湯|せんとう}は{岩盤浴|がんばんよく}もある。
examples.english: This super bathhouse also has a hot stone bath.

notes:
スーパー{銭湯|せんとう} is popular in Japan as an affordable alternative to hot spring resorts. Many offer {露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ} (outdoor baths), サウナ, {岩盤浴|がんばんよく} (hot stone baths), restaurants, and relaxation rooms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}に{行|い}く (to go to a super bathhouse)
- スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}{巡|めぐ}り (super bathhouse hopping)
- {24時間|にじゅうよじかん}スーパー{銭湯|せんとう} (24-hour super bathhouse)

RELATED TERMS:
- {銭湯|せんとう}: public bath
- {温泉|おんせん}: hot spring
- {岩盤浴|がんばんよく}: hot stone bath
- サウナ: sauna
